page_title: ELC 1-1 RSO | Elche v Real Sociedad 07/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.

90+6' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) controls a rebound and tries to catch the keeper out from long range, but it's a poor effort that sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
90+5' Isidro Diaz shows a yellow card to Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) for his blatant foul.
90+4' Eder Sarabia has decided to make a change. Andre Silva (Elche) replaces Rafa Mir.
90+3' It appears to be a head injury for Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) so no chances are being taken and he’s replaced by Aritz Elustondo.
90+1' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
90+1' Isidro Diaz has a clear sight and sees a foul from John Donald (Elche).
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' A substitution has been made. Rodrigo Mendoza is replaced by Federico Redondo Solari (Elche).
89' 1 - 1 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Matias Dituro to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
89' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is going to take the penalty!
88' David Affengruber (Elche) jumps into a tackle and Isidro Diaz signals a foul. No point in arguing there. Real Sociedad will take a penalty kick.
87' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
85' German Valera (Elche) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
84' Victor Chust goes off the pitch and Leo Petrot (Elche) comes on.
84' Eder Sarabia prepares a substitution. Marc Aguado is replaced by John Donald (Elche).
81' Substitution. Sergio Gomez is replaced by Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad).
80' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
79' Matias Dituro displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
77' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
75' It's time for a substitution. Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) comes on in place of Carlos Soler.
75' Here's the change. Brais Mendez leaves the pitch and Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Josan trots off the pitch and is replaced by Hector Fort (Elche).
74' Eder Sarabia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with German Valera (Elche) replacing Alvaro Rodriguez.
73' What was David Affengruber (Elche) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
73' 63:37 – the latest ball possession ratio. The current number of shots on goal is 3:4.
71' Josan (Elche) sends a chip pass into the box, but Alex Remiro is quickest to intercept the ball.

70' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
68' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
67' The linesman raises his flag. Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) is adjudged offside.

66' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) goes on a great individual run, arrives at the edge of the box and pulls the trigger. It was a promising effort which would have most likely gone past the goalkeeper if it hadn't been deflected by another offensive player.
65' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

65' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header directed into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop his effort. The referee signals a corner kick to Real Sociedad.
64' Substitution. Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) did his best and is replaced by Umar Sadiq.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Takefusa Kubo leaves the pitch and Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) comes on.
63' Elche have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
62' Josan (Elche) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Elche have a corner.
62' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
61' This should have been a goal! Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) sends a killer pass into the box, but Josan can't trick the opposition's defence and loses possession.
59' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
57' 1 - 0 Goal! Alvaro Nunez puts a cross into the box and finds Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the top left corner. He makes it 1:0.

56' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Josan (Elche) is going to have a crack himself.
56' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Isidro Diaz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

54' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) who directs his shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is there to stop his effort.
53' The attendance is 26242.
50' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
49' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Real Sociedad.
48' Poor challenge! Marc Aguado (Elche) is penalised for tripping and Isidro Diaz blows his whistle. Real Sociedad will take a free kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' Isidro Diaz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The resulting corner from Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) is cleared.

44' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Matias Dituro shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. It will be a corner kick for Real Sociedad.
44' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) collects a pass and strikes from about 50 metres out. It's a poor attempt which flies well wide of the right post.

42' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
42' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
41' The Elche players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
40' Victor Chust (Elche) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Josan (Elche) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
37' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) makes a slide tackle, but referee Isidro Diaz blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Elche.
37' A cross into the box from Alvaro Nunez (Elche) is cleared.
36' Real Sociedad take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
35' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play and Real Sociedad manage to earn a corner.
35' Alvaro Nunez (Elche) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Remiro comes off his line to gather the ball.

33' Goncalo Guedes sends a slide-rule pass into the feet of Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad), who without a second thought fires a shot in on goal from mid-range which only goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
32' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Elche, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.

31' What a miss! Rafa Mir (Elche) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
28' The total number of attempts is 5:3. The shots on goal statistics – 2:1.

27' Fine attempt! Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
25' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) fires a volley towards the right side of the goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save.
25' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
24' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
23' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
22' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
21' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Elche have a free kick.
19' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will take a throw-in.
16' Rafa Mir (Elche) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the right side of the goal, but is thwarted by a great save from Alex Remiro.
14' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
14' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It's a throw-in for Real Sociedad.
12' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
10' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) and Takefusa Kubo combine brilliantly in a series of one-twos.

9' Rafa Mir (Elche) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Real Sociedad win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

8' Alex Remiro makes a brilliant save! Rafa Mir (Elche) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper!
7' Isidro Diaz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Adria Pedrosa (Elche).
6' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
5' Neat passing move from Real Sociedad in order to create new attacking opportunities.

4' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
4' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
3' One of the players from Elche times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' Josan (Elche) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a throw-in.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
